blockers.from_unknown: the installed version could not be read; start the daemon so /info answers
blockers.unstamped_build: {from:%q} is an unstamped build; its schema cannot be compared with a release
blockers.downgrade: {to} is older than the installed {from}; going back is `thulu update -to {to}`
blockers.needs_intermediate: {to} upgrades only from {upgrade_from}; {from} has to go through an intermediate release first
blockers.edited_by_hand: deploy/{path} was edited by hand; move the edit to {override} and delete the file

backup.kubernetes: required, by you: snapshot the external database (PITR or a dump) and pass -backup-confirmed
backup.external: required, by you: snapshot the external database and pass -backup-confirmed
backup.bundled: taken by apply before anything changes: pg_dump of the bundled Postgres into backups/

downtime.kubernetes: none expected: the chart rolls pods and keeps the old version serving until the new one is ready
downtime.recreate: about a minute: the daemon container is recreated

rollback.nothing: nothing to roll back to: the version installed now is unknown or the same
rollback.images_auto: apply goes back to {from} on its own if the new version does not come up healthy.
rollback.images_by_hand: Later, by hand: `thulu update -to {from}`. Images only; the database stays as it is.
rollback.external_restore: Going back to {from} needs the database as it was before the update: restore your snapshot, then
rollback.external_by_hand: `thulu update -to {from} -restore {restore}`. Anything written after the update is lost.
rollback.snapshot_auto: apply goes back to {from} on its own, restoring the snapshot it took, if the new version does not come up healthy.
rollback.snapshot_by_hand: Later, by hand: `thulu update -to {from} -restore <snapshot>` with the snapshot this update records. Anything written after the update is lost.

doc.migrations_contract: - Contract (drop or rename something an older version reads): {count}
